svg.aria-label: People need people. In the age of AI it has become clear: neither intellectual nor physical work belongs to people alone anymore. Any big undertaking used to bring people together. Now you can do it on your own — you and a machine. So now we reach out to each other not out of necessity but because we want to. And we are rediscovering conversation — not as a way to get something done, but as a value in itself. I am co-founder and CEO of Mizzle Studio, an independent product studio built around this idea. If the idea that people need people feels close to you, write to me. mizzle.studio
